procedures.name: SetupNewBatch
procedures.doc: Sets up a new journal batch with default values from the journal template. Copies configuration settings like balancing account, number series, and reason codes from the template.

procedures.name: LinesExist
procedures.doc: Checks whether any journal lines exist for this journal batch. Used for validation before allowing batch deletion or modification.

procedures.name: GetBalance
procedures.doc: Calculates the total balance of all journal lines in this batch. Returns the sum of Balance (LCY) field for all lines in the batch.

procedures.name: CheckBalance
procedures.doc: Checks the balance of the journal batch and triggers appropriate events. Calls OnGeneralJournalBatchBalanced if balanced, OnGeneralJournalBatchNotBalanced if not.

procedures.name: OnGeneralJournalBatchBalanced
procedures.doc: Integration event that occurs when a general journal batch is balanced (total balance equals zero). Allows customization of behavior when journal batches achieve balance validation.

procedures.name: OnGeneralJournalBatchNotBalanced
procedures.doc: Integration event that occurs when a general journal batch is not balanced (total balance is not zero). Allows customization of error handling or warnings when journal batches fail balance validation.

procedures.name: UpdateBalAccountId
procedures.doc: Updates the Bal. Account Id field based on the current balancing account number and type. Synchronizes the system ID field with the referenced G/L Account record.

procedures.name: OnAfterSetupNewBatch
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting up a new journal batch with default configuration. Enables custom initialization of batch settings and default values.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckJnlIsNotRecurring
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking if journal batch is not recurring type. Enables custom validation logic for recurring journal restrictions.

procedures.name: OnBeforeModifyLines
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying journal lines when batch settings change. Enables custom handling of line updates during batch modification.

procedures.name: OnBeforeNoSeriesValidate
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating number series assignment on journal batch. Enables custom number series validation logic and assignment rules.

procedures.name: OnBeforeSetupNewBatch
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before setting up a new journal batch configuration. Enables custom batch creation logic and default value assignment.

procedures.name: OnGetBalanceOnAfterSetGenJournalLineFilters
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting filters on journal lines during balance calculation. Enables additional filtering criteria for balance computation.

procedures.name: SetUpNewLine
procedures.doc: Populates values of 'Order Date', 'Recurring Method' and 'Price Calculation Method' fields for a new requisition line.

procedures.name: SetDueDate
procedures.doc: Sets the value of field 'Due Date' for the current requisition line.

procedures.name: SetCurrFieldNo
procedures.doc: Sets the global variable 'CurrentFieldNo'.

procedures.name: GetPurchOrderLine
procedures.doc: Prepares and transfers relevant field values from provided purchase line to the current requisition line.

procedures.name: GetTransLine
procedures.doc: Prepares and transfers relevant field values from provided transfer line to the current requisition line.

procedures.name: GetActionMessages
procedures.doc: Runs the report 'Get Action Messages' in reference to the current requisition line.

procedures.name: GetRemainingQty
procedures.doc: Calculates values of fields 'Remaining Quantity' and 'Remaining Quantity (Base)' for the current requisition line.

procedures.name: GetReservationQty
procedures.doc: Calculates reserve quantity information for the current requisition line.

procedures.name: GetSourceCaption
procedures.doc: Combines values of 'Worksheet Template Name', 'Journal Batch Name' and 'No.' fields of the current requisition line.

procedures.name: SetReservationEntry
procedures.doc: Copies values from the current record to specified reservation entry record.

procedures.name: SetReservationFilters
procedures.doc: Sets filters from the current requisition line to specified reservation entry record.

procedures.name: ReservEntryExist
procedures.doc: Checks whether reservation entries related to the current requisition line exist.

procedures.name: SetRefOrderFilters
procedures.doc: Sets filters from provided reference document line to the current requisition line.

procedures.name: GetDirectCost
procedures.doc: Gets item unit cost of the current requisition line.

procedures.name: CalcEndingDate
procedures.doc: Calculates value for the field 'Ending Date' based on provided 'LeadTime' formula or current requisition line.

procedures.name: CalcStartingDate
procedures.doc: Calculates value for the field 'Starting Date' based on provided 'LeadTime' formula for the current requisition line.

procedures.name: TransferFromUnplannedDemand
procedures.doc: Populates corresponding values of the current requisition line in reference to the provided unplanned demand.

procedures.name: SetSupplyDates
procedures.doc: Sets values of 'Demand Date', 'Order Date', 'Starting Date' and 'Ending Date' fields of the current record based on provided 'DemandDate'.

procedures.name: SetSupplyQty
procedures.doc: Calculates demanded and needed quantities based on provided parameters 'DemandQtyBase' and 'NeededQtyBase'.

procedures.name: GetResiliencyErrors
procedures.doc: Gets all resiliency errors from the planning error log.

procedures.name: FilterLinesWithItemToPlan
procedures.doc: Filters corresponding fields of the current record based on provided item record.

procedures.name: FindLinesWithItemToPlan
procedures.doc: Gets filtered requisition line based on values from provided item record.

procedures.name: FilterLinesForReservation
procedures.doc: Sets filters on corresponding fields of requisition lines based on specified reservation entry, availability date filter and parameter 'Positive'.

procedures.name: ShowDimensions
procedures.doc: Depicts dimensions of the current requisition line.

procedures.name: GetOriginalQtyBase
procedures.doc: Calcuates original base quantity from fields 'Original Quantity' and 'Qty. per Unit of Measure' of the current requisition line.

procedures.name: IsDropShipment
procedures.doc: Checks whether the current requisition line is a drop shipment.

procedures.name: GetLocationCode
procedures.doc: Sets location code for the current requisition line record.

procedures.name: CheckGLAcc

procedures.name: TestNotSalesTax
procedures.doc: Validates that the specified field is not used when VAT Calculation Type is Sales Tax. Prevents configuration of VAT fields that are incompatible with Sales Tax calculation method.

procedures.name: GetSalesAccount
procedures.doc: Returns the appropriate sales VAT G/L account based on whether unrealized VAT is being processed. Retrieves either realized or unrealized sales VAT account with validation for required account setup.

procedures.name: GetPurchAccount
procedures.doc: Returns the appropriate purchase VAT G/L account based on whether unrealized VAT is being processed. Retrieves either realized or unrealized purchase VAT account with validation for required account setup.

procedures.name: GetRevChargeAccount
procedures.doc: Returns the appropriate reverse charge VAT G/L account based on whether unrealized VAT is being processed. Retrieves either realized or unrealized reverse charge VAT account for EU and domestic reverse charge transactions.

procedures.name: SetAccountsVisibility
procedures.doc: Sets visibility flags for unrealized VAT and payment discount adjustment based on General Ledger Setup configuration. Controls UI field visibility for VAT posting setup pages based on system-wide VAT settings.

procedures.name: SuggestSetupAccounts
procedures.doc: Suggests G/L account assignments for VAT posting setup based on existing similar setups and account patterns. Provides automated account suggestion functionality to streamline VAT posting setup configuration.

procedures.name: OnBeforeGetPurchAccount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before retrieving purchase VAT account to allow custom account selection logic. Enables extensions to override standard purchase VAT account determination based on custom business rules.

procedures.name: OnBeforeGetSalesAccount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before retrieving sales VAT account to allow custom account selection logic. Enables extensions to override standard sales VAT account determination based on custom business rules.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckSetupUsage
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking VAT posting setup usage to allow custom validation logic. Enables extensions to perform additional validation or override standard setup usage checks.

procedures.name: CheckIfDimUsed
procedures.doc: Checks if a dimension is being used in various system setups, posted entries, or budgets. This comprehensive check prevents deletion of dimensions that would cause data integrity issues.

procedures.name: CheckIfDimUsedAsAnalysisViewDim
procedures.doc: Checks if a dimension is used in analysis views and updates the usage flags accordingly. This is a helper procedure for the main CheckIfDimUsed function.

procedures.name: GetCheckDimErr
procedures.doc: Returns the formatted error message indicating where the dimension is being used. Used in conjunction with CheckIfDimUsed to provide detailed error information.

procedures.doc: Retrieves the multilanguage name for the dimension in the specified language. Falls back to the default name if no translation exists.

procedures.name: GetMLCodeCaption
procedures.doc: Retrieves the multilanguage code caption for the dimension in the specified language. Falls back to the default code caption if no translation exists.

procedures.name: GetMLFilterCaption
procedures.doc: Retrieves the multilanguage filter caption for the dimension in the specified language. Falls back to the default filter caption if no translation exists.

procedures.name: SetMLName
procedures.doc: Sets the multilanguage name for the dimension in the specified language. Updates either the main record or creates/updates a translation record.

procedures.name: SetMLCodeCaption
procedures.doc: Sets the multilanguage code caption for the dimension in the specified language. Updates either the main record or creates/updates a translation record.

procedures.name: SetMLFilterCaption
procedures.doc: Sets the multilanguage filter caption for the dimension in the specified language. Updates either the main record or creates/updates a translation record.

procedures.name: SetMLDescription
procedures.doc: Sets the multilanguage description for the dimension in the specified language. Currently only creates the translation record structure without storing the description value.

procedures.name: OnAfterDeleteRelatedRecords
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after deleting records related to a dimension being deleted. Enables cleanup of custom dimension-related data when a dimension is removed.

procedures.name: OnBeforeDeleteRelatedRecords

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckIfDimUsed
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking if a dimension is used in custom scenarios. Enables custom validation of dimension usage beyond standard Business Central checks.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckIfDimUsedAsAnalysisViewDim
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking if a dimension is used as an analysis view dimension. Enables custom logic for determining dimension usage in analysis views and related scenarios.

procedures.name: GetCaption
procedures.doc: Generates a descriptive caption for the default dimension record. Returns a formatted text showing the table name and record number for user identification.

procedures.name: UpdateGlobalDimCode
procedures.doc: Updates global dimension codes in master data records when default dimension values change. Synchronizes global dimension values across tables when dimension posting requirements change.

procedures.name: OnAfterUpdateGlobalDimCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after updating global dimension codes in master data records. Allows extensions to perform additional processing after global dimension synchronization.

procedures.name: ClearAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Clears the allowed values filter and related dimension value per account records. Called when changing from Code Mandatory posting type to allow unrestricted dimension value selection.

procedures.name: CreateDimValuePerAccountFromDimValue
procedures.doc: Creates or updates a dimension value per account record from a dimension value. Sets the Allowed flag to the value of ShouldUpdateAllowed.

procedures.name: AddDimensionValueToAllowedFilter
procedures.doc: Adds a dimension value to the allowed values filter without rebuilding from Dim. Value per Account records. Appends the value code to the filter text if not already covered by the existing filter.

procedures.name: IncludedInAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Checks whether a dimension value per account record is included in the allowed values filter. Returns true if the dimension value matches the current allowed values filter criteria.

procedures.name: UpdateDimValuesPerAccountFromAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Updates dimension values per account records based on the allowed values filter. Synchronizes the allowed dimension values list with the current filter criteria.

procedures.name: CheckDisallowedDimensionValue
procedures.doc: Validates that a dimension value is not disallowed for use with this default dimension. Prevents assignment of dimension values that are restricted by the allowed values filter.

procedures.name: UpdateDefaultDimensionAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Updates the allowed values filter field based on currently allowed dimension values. Rebuilds the filter string from dimension value per account records marked as allowed.

procedures.name: GetAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Returns the allowed values filter as a text string truncated to field length. Provides the current filter that restricts dimension value selection for this default dimension.

procedures.name: GetFullAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Returns the complete allowed values filter without length restrictions. Generates a filter string from all allowed dimension values for this default dimension.

procedures.name: UpdateParentType
procedures.doc: Updates the parent type field based on the current table ID. Maps specific table IDs to their corresponding parent type enum values.

procedures.name: UpdateParentId
procedures.doc: Updates the parent ID field based on the current table ID and record number. Links the default dimension to the correct master data record using system IDs.

procedures.name: UpdateReferencedIds
procedures.doc: Updates all referenced ID fields and modifies the record if any changes occurred. Ensures system IDs are synchronized with the current dimension and parent record references.

procedures.name: UpdateReferencedIdFields
procedures.doc: Updates all referenced ID fields and returns whether any changes were made. Coordinates updates to parent ID, parent type, dimension ID, and dimension value ID fields.

procedures.name: OnAfterSetRangeToLastFieldInPrimaryKey
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting range filters to the last field in primary key operations. Allows extensions to customize record filtering behavior during key-based searches.

procedures.name: OnBeforeValidateNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating the No. field in default dimension records. Allows extensions to implement custom validation logic or skip standard validation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeUpdateGlobalDimCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before updating global dimension codes in master data records. Allows extensions to implement custom update logic or prevent standard updates.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOnDelete
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before deleting a default dimension record. Allows extensions to perform custom validation or cleanup before deletion.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOnInsert
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before inserting a default dimension record. Allows extensions to perform custom validation or initialization before insertion.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOnModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying a default dimension record. Allows extensions to perform custom validation or processing before modification.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOnRename
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before renaming a default dimension record. Allows extensions to perform custom validation or prevent rename operations.

procedures.name: OnUpdateGLAccGlobalDimCodeOnCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised for non-standard global dimension code updates on G/L accounts. Allows extensions to handle global dimension updates beyond dimensions 1 and 2.

procedures.name: OnUpdateGLAccGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeGLAccModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying G/L account global dimension codes. Allows extensions to customize G/L account updates during global dimension synchronization.

procedures.name: OnUpdateBankGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised for non-standard global dimension code updates on bank accounts. Allows extensions to handle global dimension updates beyond dimensions 1 and 2.

procedures.name: OnUpdateBankGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeBankModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying bank account record during global dimension code update. Enables custom logic before bank account dimension values are updated.

procedures.name: OnUpdateCampaignGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised for additional global dimension code updates on campaigns beyond global dimensions 1 and 2. Enables custom dimension management for campaign records when shortcut dimensions are updated.

procedures.name: OnUpdateCustGlobalDimCodeOnCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised for additional global dimension code updates on customers beyond global dimensions 1 and 2. Enables custom dimension management for customer records when shortcut dimensions are updated.

procedures.name: OnUpdateCustGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeCustModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying customer record during global dimension code update. Enables custom logic before customer dimension values are updated.

procedures.name: OnUpdateCustomerTemplGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised for additional global dimension code updates on customer templates beyond global dimensions 1 and 2. Enables custom dimension management for customer template records when shortcut dimensions are updated.

procedures.name: OnUpdateEmpoyeeGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating employee global dimension codes for non-standard dimension numbers. Enables custom handling of global dimension updates beyond the standard two global dimensions.

procedures.name: OnUpdateEmployeeGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeEmployeeModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying employee record during global dimension update. Allows customization of employee record before dimension value assignment.

procedures.name: OnUpdateEmployeeTemplGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating employee template global dimension codes for non-standard dimension numbers. Enables custom handling of global dimension updates for employee templates.

procedures.name: OnUpdateFAGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating fixed asset global dimension codes for non-standard dimension numbers. Enables custom handling of global dimension updates for fixed assets.

procedures.name: OnUpdateFAGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeFAModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying fixed asset record during global dimension update. Allows customization of fixed asset record before dimension value assignment.

procedures.name: OnUpdateInsuranceGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating insurance global dimension codes for non-standard dimension numbers. Enables custom handling of global dimension updates for insurance records.

procedures.name: OnUpdateInsuranceGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeInsuranceModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying insurance record during global dimension update. Allows customization of insurance record before dimension value assignment.

procedures.name: OnUpdateItemGlobalDimCodeOnCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating item global dimension codes for non-standard dimension numbers. Enables custom handling of global dimension updates for items.

procedures.name: OnUpdateItemGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeItemModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying item record during global dimension update. Allows customization of item record before dimension value assignment.

procedures.name: OnUpdateItemTemplGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating item template global dimension codes for non-standard dimension numbers. Enables custom handling of global dimension updates for item templates.

procedures.name: OnUpdateJobGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating job global dimension code for cases not handled by standard processing.

procedures.name: OnUpdateJobGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeJobModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying job record when updating global dimension code.

procedures.name: OnUpdateNeutrRevGlobalDimCodeCaseElse

procedures.name: OnUpdateNeutrPayGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating neutral payment global dimension code for cases not handled by standard processing.

procedures.name: OnUpdateResGrGlobalDimCodeOnCaseElse

procedures.name: OnUpdateResGrGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeResGrModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying resource group record when updating global dimension code.

procedures.name: OnUpdateResGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating resource global dimension code for cases not handled by standard processing.

procedures.name: OnUpdateResGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeResModify

procedures.name: OnUpdateRespCenterGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating responsibility center global dimension code for cases not handled by standard processing.

procedures.name: OnUpdateRespCenterGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeRespCenterModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying responsibility center record when updating global dimension code.

procedures.name: OnUpdateSalesPurchGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating salesperson/purchaser global dimension code for cases not handled by standard processing.

procedures.name: OnUpdateVendGlobalDimCodeOnCaseElse

procedures.name: OnUpdateVendGlobalDimCodeOnBeforeVendModify

procedures.name: OnUpdateVendorTemplGlobalDimCodeCaseElse
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when updating vendor template global dimension code for cases not handled by standard processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeSetRangeToLastFieldInPrimaryKey
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before setting range filter to the last field in primary key during default dimension validation. Enables custom field identification logic and primary key range filtering.

procedures.name: OnGetCaptionOnAfterAssignNewNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after assigning new table number during caption generation. Enables custom caption formatting and table name resolution for specialized tables.

procedures.name: OnBeforeValidateTableID
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating Table ID field assignment. Enables custom table ID validation logic and table existence verification.

procedures.name: OnBeforeValidateAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating Allowed Values Filter field assignment. Enables custom filter validation logic and dimension value constraint verification.

procedures.name: OnUpdateDefaultDimensionAllowedValuesFilterOnAfterGetAllowedValuesFilter

procedures.name: OnAfterGetRemainingPmtDiscPossible
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after getting remaining payment discount possible. Enables customization of payment discount calculations based on specific business rules.

procedures.name: OnAfterRecalculateAmounts
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after recalculating amounts in currency conversion. Enables custom processing when amounts are converted between currencies.

procedures.name: InsertDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Inserts or updates a detailed CV ledger entry buffer record with consolidation logic. Combines entries with matching key fields to avoid duplicate buffer records.

procedures.name: CopyPostingGroupsFromVATEntry
procedures.doc: Copies posting group fields from a VAT entry to the detailed CV ledger entry buffer. Used for VAT-related detailed entries to maintain proper posting setup references.

procedures.name: CopyFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Copies relevant fields from a general journal line to create an initial detailed CV ledger entry. Sets up the buffer with transaction amounts, dimensions, and basic posting information.

procedures.name: InitFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Initializes the detailed CV ledger entry buffer with basic posting information from a general journal line. Sets up document and user identification fields without amounts or detailed data.

procedures.name: CopyFromCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Copies key reference fields from a CV ledger entry buffer to establish parent-child relationship. Links the detailed entry to its parent ledger entry with currency and dimension information.

procedures.name: InitDetailedCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Initializes and inserts a complete detailed CV ledger entry buffer with specified amounts and application data. Creates fully populated detailed entry for payment applications, discounts, and tolerance scenarios.

procedures.name: FindVATEntry
procedures.doc: Finds the corresponding VAT entry for the detailed CV ledger entry using transaction number and posting groups. Used to link detailed entries with their related VAT transactions for reporting and analysis.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying fields from a general journal line to the detailed CV ledger entry buffer. Enables customization of field mapping and additional data population from journal lines.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyFromCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying reference fields from a CV ledger entry buffer. Enables customization of field mapping and additional data population from parent ledger entries.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyPostingGroupsFromVATEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying posting groups from a VAT entry. Enables customization of VAT-related posting group assignments and validation.

procedures.name: OnAfterInitFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after initializing basic fields from a general journal line. Enables customization of initialization logic and additional field setup.

procedures.name: OnAfterInsertDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after inserting a detailed CV ledger entry buffer record. Enables post-processing of inserted detailed entries and related buffer updates.

procedures.name: OnBeforeInsertDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before inserting a detailed CV ledger entry buffer in the initialization process. Enables custom validation and processing before detailed entry creation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCreateDtldCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before creating a detailed CV ledger entry buffer during consolidation. Enables custom logic for entry consolidation and duplicate detection.

procedures.name: OnInsertDtldCVLedgEntryOnBeforeInsert
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before inserting a new detailed CV ledger entry buffer record. Enables final validation and field modifications before database insertion.

procedures.name: OnInsertDtldCVLedgEntryOnBeforeModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying an existing detailed CV ledger entry buffer during consolidation. Enables custom logic for amount aggregation and field updates in consolidated entries.

procedures.name: OnInsertDtldCVLedgEntryOnBeforeNewDtldCVLedgEntryBufInit
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before initializing a new detailed CV ledger entry buffer during the insertion process. Enables custom setup and field population before detailed entry processing begins.

procedures.name: IncrAmounts
procedures.doc: Increments amounts in the current record with amounts from another prepayment invoice line buffer. Adds all financial amounts including VAT, base amounts, and discount amounts.

procedures.name: ReverseAmounts
procedures.doc: Reverses all amounts in the current record by changing signs. Used for creating credit memo entries or reversing prepayment entries.

procedures.name: SetAmounts
procedures.doc: Sets the financial amounts for the prepayment invoice line buffer. Updates amount, VAT amounts, and base amounts in both LCY and ACY.

procedures.name: InsertInvLineBuffer
procedures.doc: Inserts or updates a prepayment invoice line buffer record. If record exists, increments amounts; otherwise inserts new record.

procedures.name: CopyWithLineNo
procedures.doc: Copies a prepayment invoice line buffer record with a new line number. Creates a new record with the specified line number.

procedures.name: CopyFromPurchLine
procedures.doc: Copies posting group information from a purchase line to the prepayment buffer. Transfers VAT and posting group settings for prepayment processing.

procedures.name: CopyFromSalesLine
procedures.doc: Copies posting group information from a sales line to the prepayment buffer. Transfers VAT and posting group settings for prepayment processing.

procedures.name: SetFilterOnPKey
procedures.doc: Sets filters on the primary key fields of the prepayment invoice line buffer. Used for finding existing records with matching key values.

procedures.name: FillAdjInvLineBuffer
procedures.doc: Fills the buffer with adjustment invoice line data for amount corrections. Creates adjustment entries for prepayment amount differences.

procedures.name: UpdatePresentationOrder
procedures.doc: Updates the hierarchical presentation order and indentation level based on the category's position in the tree structure. Calculates the sort order for proper display sequence in financial reports and user interfaces.

procedures.name: InitializeDataSet
procedures.doc: Initializes the account category dataset with standard financial statement structure. Creates default categories for Assets, Liabilities, Equity, Income, Cost of Goods Sold, and Expenses.

procedures.name: InsertRow
procedures.doc: Creates a new account category as a sibling of the current category with default settings. Returns the entry number of the newly created category for further processing.

procedures.name: MoveUp
procedures.doc: Moves the current account category up one position in the sibling sequence within the same parent level. Updates presentation order and descendant categories accordingly.

procedures.name: MoveDown
procedures.doc: Moves the current account category down one position in the sibling sequence within the same parent level. Updates presentation order and descendant categories accordingly.

procedures.name: MakeChildOfPreviousSibling
procedures.doc: Changes the current category to become a child of its previous sibling category. Restructures the hierarchy by moving the category down one level in the tree.

procedures.name: MakeSiblingOfParent
procedures.doc: Changes the current category to become a sibling of its parent category. Restructures the hierarchy by moving the category up one level in the tree.

procedures.name: DeleteRow
procedures.doc: Deletes the current category and all its child categories from the hierarchy. Removes associated account assignments and updates related financial reports.

procedures.name: MapAccounts
procedures.doc: Maps general ledger accounts to this category (placeholder for future implementation). Provides extension point for custom account mapping logic.

procedures.name: ValidateTotaling
procedures.doc: Validates and assigns a new totaling filter for general ledger accounts in this category. Updates account assignments and clears previous totaling assignments as needed.

procedures.name: LookupTotaling
procedures.doc: Opens a lookup page to select G/L accounts for the Totaling field. Provides a filtered view based on the category's Income/Balance setting.

procedures.name: PositiveNormalBalance
procedures.doc: Determines if the account category has a positive normal balance. Returns true for Expense, Assets, and Cost of Goods Sold categories.

procedures.name: GetBalance
procedures.doc: Calculates the total balance for this account category including all child categories. Processes both totaling accounts and hierarchical child categories.

procedures.name: GetTotaling
procedures.doc: Gets the totaling filter string for this account category. Returns the account filter used for calculating category totals.

procedures.name: ShowNotificationAccSchedUpdateNeeded
procedures.doc: Shows a notification that account schedules need to be updated when categories change. Helps maintain consistency between account categories and financial reporting.

procedures.name: GetAccSchedUpdateNeededNotificationId
procedures.doc: Returns the unique identifier for the account schedule update needed notification. Used for notification management and user preferences.

procedures.name: DontNotifyCurrentUserAgain
procedures.doc: Disables the account schedule update notification for the current user. Allows users to opt out of future notifications about category updates.

procedures.name: OnBeforeGetTotaling
procedures.doc: Integration event that allows customization of the GetTotaling procedure. Subscribers can provide custom totaling logic before the standard calculation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeMove
procedures.doc: Integration event that allows customization of the category move operation. Subscribers can implement custom logic before moving account categories.

procedures.name: OnBeforeUpdateDescendants
procedures.doc: Integration event that allows customization of descendant category updates. Subscribers can implement custom logic before updating child categories.

procedures.name: OnBeforeUpdatePresentationOrder
procedures.doc: Integration event that allows customization of presentation order updates. Subscribers can implement custom logic before updating category display order.

procedures.name: OnBeforeValidateTotaling
procedures.doc: Integration event that allows customization of totaling validation. Subscribers can implement custom validation logic before totaling field changes.

procedures.name: OnGetBalanceOnAfterGetTotaling
procedures.doc: Integration event that allows customization of balance calculation after totaling. Subscribers can modify the balance calculation based on totaling results.

procedures.name: OnGetBalanceOnBeforeProcessChildren
procedures.doc: Integration event that allows customization of balance calculation before processing child categories. Subscribers can modify the balance calculation before child category processing.

procedures.name: OpenSetupCard
procedures.doc: Opens the setup card page for this payment service configuration. Allows users to modify provider-specific settings and parameters.

procedures.name: CreateReportingArgs
procedures.doc: Creates payment reporting arguments for a specific document and its associated payment services. Generates the data needed for payment provider integration and customer communication.

procedures.name: GetDefaultPaymentServices
procedures.doc: Retrieves payment services configured to be always included on documents. Returns a set ID for enabled payment services that are set to be included by default.

procedures.name: SelectPaymentService
procedures.doc: Presents payment service selection dialog to user and returns the selected set ID. Handles the complete workflow for selecting payment services including setup prompts.

procedures.name: SaveSet
procedures.doc: Saves a temporary payment service setup collection as a persistent set. Converts temporary payment service records into a record set that can be referenced by ID.

procedures.name: LoadSet
procedures.doc: Loads a payment service set into temporary records based on the provided set ID. Marks payment services as available based on their inclusion in the specified set.

procedures.name: GetSelectedPaymentsText
procedures.doc: Returns a comma-separated text string of selected payment service names. Provides user-friendly display of payment services included in a set.

procedures.name: CanChangePaymentService
procedures.doc: Determines if payment service configuration can be changed for a given document. Validates document status and payment method compatibility for payment service modifications.

procedures.name: ChangePaymentServicePostedInvoice
procedures.doc: Enables changing payment service configuration for a posted sales invoice. Updates the payment service set ID on the posted invoice and provides user feedback.

procedures.name: IsPaymentServiceVisible
procedures.doc: Checks if payment services are available for display in user interfaces. Determines visibility of payment service functionality based on registered providers.

procedures.name: NewPaymentService
procedures.doc: Initiates creation of a new payment service through the setup workflow. Handles provider selection and setup dialog presentation to the user.

procedures.name: AssignPrimaryKey
procedures.doc: Assigns the primary key for a payment service setup record based on its setup record ID. Ensures unique identification of payment service configurations.

procedures.name: DeletePaymentServiceSetup
procedures.doc: Deletes the underlying payment service setup record referenced by the Setup Record ID. Performs cleanup of related configuration data when removing payment services.

procedures.name: TermsOfServiceDrillDown
procedures.doc: Opens the Terms of Service URL in the default browser or application. Enables users to review payment service provider terms and conditions.

procedures.name: OnRegisterPaymentServices
procedures.doc: Integration event for registering available payment services in the system. Enables extensions to add custom payment service configurations.

procedures.name: OnRegisterPaymentServiceProviders
procedures.doc: Integration event for registering payment service providers and their capabilities. Allows extensions to define new payment provider types and configurations.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCanUsePaymentMethod
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking if a payment method can be used. Enables custom validation logic for payment method availability.

procedures.name: OnCreatePaymentService
procedures.doc: Integration event for custom payment service creation logic. Allows extensions to perform additional setup when creating payment services.

procedures.name: OnDoNotIncludeAnyPaymentServicesOnAllDocuments
procedures.doc: Integration event raised when removing payment services from all documents. Enables custom cleanup logic when disabling payment service integration.

procedures.name: OnCanChangePaymentServiceOnAfterGetRecordRef
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after determining document context for payment service changes. Enables custom validation logic for payment service modification permissions.

procedures.name: GetTargetURL
procedures.doc: Retrieves the target URL from the BLOB field as a text string. Extracts the payment service URL for use in web requests and redirects.

procedures.name: SetTargetURL
procedures.doc: Sets the target URL by storing it in the BLOB field after validation. Validates that the URL is properly formatted and uses HTTP/HTTPS protocol.

procedures.name: TrySetTargetURL
procedures.doc: Attempts to set the target URL with error handling. Returns success/failure status without throwing exceptions.

procedures.name: GetCurrencyCode
procedures.doc: Returns the currency code, defaulting to local currency if not specified. Ensures a valid currency code is always available for payment processing.

procedures.name: GetPayPalServiceID
procedures.doc: Returns the service identifier for PayPal payment processing. Used to identify PayPal as the selected payment service provider.

procedures.name: GetMSWalletServiceID
procedures.doc: Returns the service identifier for Microsoft Wallet payment processing. Used to identify Microsoft Wallet as the selected payment service provider.

procedures.name: GetWorldPayServiceID
procedures.doc: Returns the service identifier for WorldPay payment processing. Used to identify WorldPay as the selected payment service provider.

procedures.name: GetPayPalLogoFile
procedures.doc: Returns the filename for the PayPal logo image resource. Used for displaying PayPal branding in payment interfaces.

procedures.name: GetMSWalletLogoFile
procedures.doc: Returns the filename for the Microsoft Wallet logo image resource. Used for displaying Microsoft branding in payment interfaces.

procedures.name: GetWorldPayLogoFile
procedures.doc: Returns the filename for the WorldPay logo image resource. Used for displaying WorldPay branding in payment interfaces.

procedures.name: GetWebServiceURL
procedures.doc: Retrieves the web service URL from BLOB storage with extensibility for URL transformation. Triggers OnAfterGetWebServiceURL event for custom URL modification.

procedures.name: SetWebServiceURL
procedures.doc: Validates and stores a web service URL in BLOB field after security validation. Ensures URLs meet HTTP/HTTPS protocol requirements.

procedures.name: CreateDataExchangeDefinition
procedures.doc: Creates complete Data Exchange Definition setup for currency exchange rate import. Establishes Data Exchange Definition, Line Definition, and Field Mapping records.

procedures.name: GetXMLStructure
procedures.doc: Analyzes XML structure of web service response for data exchange mapping setup. Populates XML Buffer with node hierarchy for configuration purposes.

procedures.name: VerifyDataExchangeLineDefinition
procedures.doc: Validates that data exchange definition has proper XML node configuration. Ensures Data Line Tag is configured before enabling service.

procedures.name: VerifyServiceURL
procedures.doc: Validates that web service URL is configured before enabling service.

procedures.name: ShowJobQueueEntry
procedures.doc: Opens Job Queue Entry card for monitoring scheduled currency updates. Supports extensibility through OnShowJobQueueEntryOnBeforeJobQueueEntryFindFirst event.

procedures.name: SetupService
procedures.doc: Initializes exchange rate service configuration when no services exist. Runs setup codeunit with error handling and telemetry logging.

procedures.name: OnAfterGetWebServiceURL
procedures.doc: Allows customization of web service URLs after retrieval from storage.

procedures.name: OnBeforeSetupCurrencyExchRateService
procedures.doc: Enables customization of currency exchange rate service setup process.

procedures.name: OnBeforeEnsureURLIsHttpAndValidUri
procedures.doc: Provides extensibility for custom URL validation logic before storing service URLs.

procedures.name: OnShowJobQueueEntryOnBeforeJobQueueEntryFindFirst
procedures.doc: Allows customization of job queue entry lookup when displaying scheduling information.

procedures.name: OnBeforeAutoUpdateExchangeRates
procedures.doc: Enables customization of automatic exchange rate update scheduling and execution.
